name: The Hunter's Path
summary: In Durotar, The Hunter's Path sends young orc and troll hunters to Razor Hill. There, Thotar teaches them to bind wild predators.

sections.title: A Hunter's Awakening
sections.body: In Durotar, young hunters learn to track prey with bow and cunning. Following trails through red clay canyons and harsh scrubland teaches patience. To master the hunter's way in the Horde, they must also learn to bond with the land's wild beasts. When class trainers judge a student ready, they direct them to Razor Hill.

sections.title: The Master at Razor Hill
sections.body: Thotar waits at Razor Hill, where he teaches young hunters how to subdue Durotar's fierce beasts without breaking their spirit. Learning from him begins the path to traveling the wilderness with a loyal companion.

faq.q: What is the purpose of The Hunter's Path?
faq.answer: The Hunter's Path sends young orc and troll hunters to Razor Hill to begin learning how to tame beasts.
Thotar is a veteran hunter at Razor Hill who teaches young Horde trackers to bond with and command wild beasts.

faq.q: Why can't young hunters tame pets immediately?
aliases: why must hunters wait for pets
faq.answer: Young hunters need discipline, patience, and special training to control dangerous predators. Without basic survival skills, they risk being mauled or killed.

faq.q: Which races undertake this specific trial?
aliases: is this for orcs and trolls only
faq.answer: Orcs and Darkspear trolls in Durotar undertake this trial, while tauren hunters face a similar one in Mulgore.

faq.q: What happens after reporting to Thotar?
faq.answer: After you report to Thotar, he sends you to track and subdue native predators across Durotar to prove your skill at taming beasts.

faq.q: Where does this training take place?
faq.answer: The training centers on Razor Hill, the main settlement in central Durotar, between the Valley of Trials and Orgrimmar.

angles.text: As a hunter, you cross from fighting alone to learning how to command beasts.
As an orc hunter, you follow a tradition tied to the wolf riders of Draenor when you take a fierce companion.
As a Darkspear hunter, you learn to tame local raptors and boars to find your footing in Durotar's dangerous wilds.
As a member of the Horde, you help its scouts and trackers tame Durotar's predators and turn the harsh land to your people's advantage.
